name: Sudou Junko
source:
She has a calm and gentle atmosphere, and is what one would call a mood reader. She is very considerate and shows a kindness that does not discriminate between people. 

Although she looks young, she is already over 30 years old and married with no children.

[From [url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/bh/bihf003/index.html]official site[/url]]
